أنسرح (form VII)
# أَنْسَرِحُ (ʔansariḥu) /ʔan.sa.ri.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
# أَنْسَرِحَ (ʔansariḥa) /ʔan.sa.ri.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
# أَنْسَرِحْ (ʔansariḥ) /ʔan.sa.riħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
